h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dewas

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dewas

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dewas

c: Dewas is an industrial town on the Malwa plateau, close to Indore, and is known for the Chamunda Mata temple on the Tekri hill that overlooks it. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Dewas to factory campuses in its industrial area, schools, colleges, municipal gardens and residential colonies. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 520 km away, and deliver by road.

Malwa has hot days in summer but cooler nights than much of central India, and the monsoon is moderate. That means an open gym here gets used both early in the morning and late in the evening for most of the year. Factory campuses often want a gym that staff on different shifts can use without supervision. Colonies want a set that works for families. We build every machine on a galvanised frame with roto-moulded parts, and grout or self-stand it to suit the ground.

items.q: Can a factory in Dewas set up an outdoor gym for staff?
items.a: Yes. Send us the space and the number of staff on each shift. We will suggest machines, send a layout drawing and a quote, and install after approval.
They use the person's own body weight and need no adjustment. A simple instruction board beside each station is enough for most users.
Yes. We deliver by road to Indore, Dewas and nearby towns, and install with our own team or a dealer covering central India.
